stable.notes: Title block with part number and Approved by (Project Properties); photos capped on Qt, Pillow out of the build (~11 MB smaller); a run from source refuses a Visual C++ runtime older than Qt needs; dead-code sweep (46 uncalled functions); docs brought back in line with the code. Also: Build → Export Connection Sheet… (OBR pin-list layout, Changelog sheet), Parts Database Open photos folder, function names by what the wire does (Step 1), connector-face fixes.

beta.notes:
WireProof 0.60.0 (beta)

- Catalog picker: Parts Database → Devices → Add and the node dialog's + Add Connector open a searchable, filterable table of every catalog connector with thumbnails, a photo and the notes; Ctrl-click adds several at once.
- Faces…: the faces list is the same browser — filters, a layout thumbnail per face, the REAR preview with the linked housings and checks, the face sheet on a click.
- Assign remote cavity: the spare-pin pick is a table (connector - cavity in natural order, C-number, function, aliases, device note).
- DRC: the "Net: two sources" rule is removed (it tripped on every device-first wire); shared pin and loose end stay.
- Crash diagnostics: Qt's own warnings and fatal messages are in the session log; the installer build refuses a dist without the Visual C++ 14.40 runtime.
- Fixed: a device save dropped a connector row whose catalog id the Devices tab did not know.
- First start pulls the catalog once (the snapshot shape changed). No database migrations.
